evidence.observation: Pressure held steady near 3.02-3.04 Torr through the ramp and early growth.
Pressure rose steadily with no sign of levelling off, from 3.04 to 3.48 Torr (about 15%) over 600 s.
Argon flow steady at about 100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not caused by extra gas going in.
Temperature holding at 750 °C and heater power steady (about 45%), so the thermal side looks normal.
No exhaust oxygen sensor installed, so an air leak cannot be told apart from an exhaust blockage.

args.missing_evidence: Something that tells a seal leak (air getting in) from an exhaust blockage: a pump-down and leak-rate check with the tube isolated, a check of whether pressure follows a step change in argon flow, a portable oxygen or leak check at the exhaust, or a look at the exhaust line and pump. No characterization of the sample exists yet.
